note: Re-quoted to the Open Word Bible, Balanced edition (owb-ja, CC0), per the founder decision that Japanese quotes OWB for every work (2026-11-19); it replaces the 口語訳 (japkougo) wording the translation first shipped with.

A `mined` row is a quotation (cited, uncited, or a verbatim recitation without marks) whose every piece is exact OWB, checked against the bundled text: a span of the verse, or pieces of it joined with '……'; a nested quotation's inner 「」 is written 『』. Two places keep a character's own words around the recited verse (Gen 24:31 「主に祝福された方、どうぞお入りください。…」; Acts 9:34 「元気を出せ。…」). block_index counts per chapter (chapter_order).

A `self_rendered` row is one of Bunyan's marginal references to an allusion or to his own paraphrase (most of the book's citations), or a quotation he adapts (person, tense, a token spoken to the pilgrim); a row's `note` gives the reason where OWB cannot serve a quotation at all.
1 Corinthians 5:10 was cited 第一コリント4:10 in the first edition (the English prints 5:10); the citation is corrected.
